review_candidates.title: GitHub Contributor - Remote
review_candidates.description: Role Title: GitHub Contributor Role Type : Contractor (~15 hrs a week) Location: Remote Expert Senior Software Engineers to support a customer’s innovative project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. As an expert you will be creating Reinforcement Learning Environments which test and AI model’s ability to solve complex software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and golden reference solution for the problem. Applicants must have clear open source contributions and profiles to showcase it like GitHub or GitLab. (Preferably with C++, Python, JAVA, GoLang, Typescript, or Rust) Scope of Work Contribute expert-level code samples, debugging strategies, and development insights in Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects and performance bottlenecks in diverse codebases. Implement robust new features, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to software best practices. Refactor and optimize legacy code to improve clarity, efficiency, and long-term reliability. Document technical reasoning, solution approaches, and code decisions to enhance AI training data quality. Review and validate peer-contributed code and technical submissions for accuracy and clarity. Preferred Qualifications Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization. Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery within cross-functional projects. Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly. Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required). Process Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions Complete AI interview (aprox. 30 minutes) Technical Assessment (Tentative) Hiring Manager review Compensation Structure Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding. Skills: c,code,software,github,java,rust,typescript

review_candidates.title: Sr Backend Developer
review_candidates.description: Senior Backend Developer - Java & Spring Boot Description Valleysoft is a regional IT services provider delivering enterprise software, process management, and technology solutions for global clients. Working across the Information Technology and Services sector, the company supports complex business needs with reliable, scalable systems built for real-world enterprise environments.   This role offers the opportunity to contribute to backend systems that power business-critical platforms and integrations. As a Senior Backend Developer – Java & Spring Boot, you will help shape robust application architecture, improve system performance, and build services that support secure, dependable digital experiences for enterprise clients.   You will play a hands-on role in the design and evolution of backend services, working closely with cross-functional teams across design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. The position is well suited to someone who enjoys technical ownership, values clean engineering practices, and brings a thoughtful approach to building maintainable, high-performance software.   Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. Develop and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performance RESTful APIs. Design and implement backend services following clean architecture, OOP principles, design patterns, and SOLID practices. Build and support integrations with internal and external enterprise systems. Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to design, query, and optimize data access. Implement API security using technologies such as JWT and OAuth 2.0. Write and maintain unit and integration tests. Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes, and deliver effective technical solutions. Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability. Participate in code reviews and collaborate with cross-functional teams across design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Take ownership of backend features and services from requirements through production. Prepare and maintain technical documentation. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years of hands-on backend development experience with strong production experience in Java and Spring Boot. Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs, including performance tuning and optimization of backend services, APIs, and database interactions. Experience building enterprise system integrations with third-party and internal services. Strong experience with SQL databases, particularly Oracle and/or SQL Server, along with experience optimizing data access in production environments. Experience with API security using JWT and OAuth 2.0. Strong unit and integration testing experience using tools such as JUnit and Mockito. Experience with production support and troubleshooting, including root-cause analysis and resolving critical issues. Experience owning backend features or services from requirements through development, testing, deployment, and production. Experience with microservices architecture and distributed backend services. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including frontend or mobile developers, QA, DevOps, business analysts or product owners, solution architects or technical leads, database teams or DBAs, production support or operations teams, and other developers through code reviews and technical discussions. Experience in Banking or FinTech. Preferred Qualifications Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB. Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud or containerized environments. Experience with payment systems, digital banking, cards, wallets, or financial APIs. Experience collaborating with Security or InfoSec teams, particularly for API security and authentication. Experience coordinating across distributed or offshore and onshore teams.
